method: Frozen public list-price profiles. Free allowances are subtracted from total account usage before paid tiers are applied. Projected workload cost is the marginal account cost: cost(other plus workload) minus cost(other). Taxes, commitments, negotiated discounts, operations, retrieval, replication, acceleration, and provider-specific exceptions are excluded.

transport.free_allowance_note: 100 GB/month aggregate data transfer out to the internet across eligible AWS services and regions; other account usage may consume it first.

storage.free_allowance_note: No free allowance modeled in this frozen S3 Standard profile.
